name: Attention Seekers
overview: Scripture warns against seeking human praise and recognition, emphasizing that true honor comes only from God. Proverbs instructs believers to let others praise them rather than boasting themselves, while Jesus cautions against performing righteous acts to be seen by men, as such motives forfeit heavenly reward. The deceitfulness of the heart and the fleeting nature of human approval are highlighted, reminding believers to cease relying on man and instead prioritize seeking God's kingdom and righteousness above all. Faith is undermined when one desires honor from others rather than from God alone.
